comparison.objective: Seat a keyed coupling and prove torque transfer, not set and lock an adjustable stop.
comparison.physical_skill: Align unequal drive dogs, insert the coupling, and rotate a rotor through it.
comparison.success_condition: Coupling remains seated after release and measured drive transfers across it.
comparison.reason: Functional verification is shared, but coupling insertion and drive engagement are different from preserving an adjustable stop under locknut torque.
